speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have been experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To begin my assessment, how many days ago did your sinusitis treatment start, and which specific antibiotic was prescribed?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did your fever and flank pain persist immediately after your sinusitis symptoms resolved, or did they appear later? Please also tell me if you noticed any changes in your urine color, frequency, or if you have experienced any pain while urinating.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis (likely post-streptococcal or drug-induced, given the rash and flank pain).
